LFPB.notes: Disbursement applied to catering and airport fee. EXECUJET handling order LBG-15459 (2 Nov 2026; A6-AFC GLEX XRS 45.13 t, Saturday 31 Oct 2026 11:18–20:18 UTC, 2 + 3 pax, card; EUR): ground handling 1,320 (45–52 t), 10% discount −132, weekend surcharge 50% 660 (on undiscounted amount), security 420, parking up to 24 h 1,015, GPU 5 × 15 min × 90, dish washing 140.04 and catering 1,106.35 (+15%, not entered), card 1.5% 77.50. USER DECISIONS (6 Nov 2026): 10% discount not reflected in panel (handling 1,320); card 1.5% as tick percentage row (ExecuJet); France, Europe/Paris. EXECUJET receipt (T7-ELL GLEX, 05 Nov 08:28Z – 07 Nov 10:10Z 2026, 3 + 3 pax, EUR, no VAT): ground handling 1,320, 10% discount −132, weekend surcharge 50% 660, security 420, parking 3 × 24 h × 1,015 = 3,045, lavatory 110, GPU 2 × 15 min × 90 = 180, laundry to follow (not entered), limousine 150 + 15% = 172.50, card 1.5% 86.63; total 5,862.13. USER DECISIONS (12 Nov 2026): parking after 24 h charged per started 24 h (all groups); 10% discount as tick row (untick = full price); lavatory 110; GPU row priced per 30 min (gpuPer 0.5); limousine as tick row with 15% disbursement. EXECUJET invoices (issued 14 Nov 2026, VAT 20% charged): T7-AFZ GL7T, Sunday 15 Nov 2026 10:10–13:00Z, 3 + 3 pax: ground handling 1,430 (52–63 t), discount −10% −143, weekend surcharge 50% 715, security 540, parking 1–3 h 450, parking 24 h 1,200 × 0, card 1.5% 53.86 (on total incl. VAT 3,590.40); total 3,045.86 excl. VAT. A6-AFA GLEX, Monday 16 Nov 2026 09:25–14:30Z, 2 + 1 pax: ground handling 1,320 (45–52 t), discount −132, security 420, parking up to 24 h 1,015, card 1.5% 47.21 (on total incl. VAT); total 2,670.21 excl. VAT. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): card fee stays 1.5% on net total (panel a few euros below when VAT is charged); GL7T parking 1–3 h 450 (previously 451); prices date-confirmed 14 Nov 2026. Types from ops system (16 Nov 2026): Universal Aviation France, Jet Aviation, ExecuJet Paris, Dassault Falcon Service and Advanced Air Support International FBO. SIGNATURE AVIATION added as a sixth handler (quotation of 17 Nov 2026 for A6-AFE, MTOW 43 t, LFPB 1-4 Dec 2026; prices effective from December 2025, excl. 20% VAT). Signature prices handling per movement ('half handling'), so the panel's turnaround row carries twice the quoted figure. The quotation gives four handling rates: low season (Jan, Feb, Apr, May, Nov, Dec) off peak 822 and peak 1,241; high season (Mar, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct) off peak 904 and peak 1,324. The panel holds one rate per group, and by user decision of 17 Nov 2026 it carries the season we are in - low season off peak, 822 x 2 = 1,644. In high season the off-peak turnaround is 1,808 and the peak turnaround 2,648; to be switched over when the season changes. Peak days are Monday, Wednesday and public holidays, entered as the weekend mechanism with wkDays Monday and Wednesday and a flat 838 (the low-season peak difference, 1,241 - 822, doubled); in high season that difference is 840. Out of hours 22:00-06:00 local is a flat 848. Parking: 70 per hour for short stops, 1,334 per started 24 h, 1,134 per day from 3 days and 1,067 per day from 4 days, entered as graduated bands; the hourly rate is cheaper below about 19 hours but the panel holds one structure, so the daily bands are used and the hourly rate is kept in the row description. Security 418, toilet 174, water 174, GPU 123 per 15 min = 246 per 30 min, pushback 670, aircraft towing 303. NEW ROWS: Pushback and Aircraft Towing, which LFPB did not have; the user confirmed both are general prices rather than aircraft-type dependent, so they are filled in every Signature group, while the rest of that quotation first filled the GL5T group only; the price list of 18 Nov 2026 then filled the other five groups, as set out at the end of this note. Disbursement 16% on third-party invoices, above the 15% of ExecuJet, Dassault, Jet Aviation and Universal and the 8% of Advanced Air Support. Cancellation: 50% of the handling rate within 48 h, 100% within 24 h; not entered as rows. Super peak days are subject to change for special events. Security night surcharge 100% means the security fee itself doubles when a movement falls at night (user clarification 17 Nov 2026), so it is entered as a separate row of 418, equal to the security fee, which the panel shows in the Surcharge section with its own apply box, unticked by default, and counts once per flight when arrival or departure falls in the window. The window 22:00-06:00 is taken from the out-of-hours line, which the quotation does not restate for security. The flat out-of-hours charge 848 stays alongside it; the two are separate charges. On this quotation Signature is the most expensive handler at LFPB: for 1-4 Dec 2026 (Tuesday arrival, Friday departure, neither a peak day, three days parking) handling 1,644 + security 418 + parking 3,402 = 5,464 against ExecuJet's 1,320 + 420 + 3,045 = 4,785, and ExecuJet also carries a 10% handling discount. DASSAULT FALCON SERVICE quotation 17 Nov 2026 (A6-AFE, headed 'Global Express 44-54 t', LFPB 1-4 Dec 2026): handling 1,233, parking up to 24 h 942, security check 237, GPU 94 per 15 min = 188 per 30 min, toilet service 155 with deogel included in winter, water tank service 111. The 44-54 t band covers GL5T, GLEX and GL7T, and by user decision of 17 Nov 2026 the handling 1,233 was written to all three, replacing 923 in GL5T and 986 in GLEX and GL7T; security 237 replaces 177 in GL5T and was re-confirmed in GLEX and GL7T, which already held it. GPU 188 and toilet 155 were written to all six groups, since this handler does not vary them by aircraft group, and water 111 was unchanged and re-confirmed. Parking is entered as the quotation states it, a 24 h band of 942 added to the existing 12 h bands; the quotation gives no rate beyond 24 h, so GL5T still has none and GLEX and GL7T keep the earlier 39.25 per hour, which happens to be exactly 942 over 24 h. The three free hours in the parking object come from earlier data and the quotation does not mention them; left as they are, to be checked against the next invoice. The 50% extra charge applies on Sundays and bank holidays only, not Saturdays, so this handler carries wkDays Sunday while the other LFPB handlers keep the default weekend. JET AVIATION: Administration & Communication Fee 40 per flight added by the user on 18 Nov 2026, the same in all six groups; new row, the other handlers left empty. Marshalling 30 per flight added on 18 Nov 2026 from the Jet Aviation document of 16 Nov 2026, the same in all six groups, as a new row ticked by default, since the panel's basket rule does not pick that name up on its own. Pushback 195 entered in all six groups by user decision of 18 Nov 2026 (it was first put in GL5T only); the other handlers are empty in both of these rows. MARSHALLING was moved into the basket on 18 Nov 2026 by user decision, so the row sits among the handling services and counts by default; the tickDef flag it carried until then was removed, the basket flag replacing it. SIGNATURE PRICE LIST received by e-mail on 18 Nov 2026 (Signature Flight Support LBG; prices effective from December 2025, excl. 20% VAT). It gives two MTOW bands and so fills the five groups that until then read 'Basic Ground Handling not provided'. Band 36-60 t covers GL7T, GLEX, GL5T and GLF4: half handling low season off peak 822 and peak 1,241, high season off peak 904 and peak 1,324; parking 70 per hour, 1,334 per 24 h, 1,134 per day from 3 days, 1,067 per day from 4 days; security 418; out of hours 848. Band 18-25 t covers E35L and CL60: half handling low season off peak 420 and peak 634, high season off peak 461 and peak 677; parking 32 per hour, 611 per 24 h, 519 per day from 3 days, 489 per day from 4 days; security 255; out of hours 433. The list repeats the figures of the 17 Nov 2026 quotation for the heavy band to the euro, which confirms that quotation was the 36-60 t band, so GL5T keeps its values unchanged. Handling rows carry the low season off peak turnaround, 822 x 2 = 1,644 on the heavy band and 420 x 2 = 840 on the light band; in high season they become 1,808 and 922, to be switched when the season changes. The list puts GLF4 in the 36-60 t band although A6-FLH is about 33.8 t, and it names a GL6T band, which is T7-ELL, an aircraft the panel keeps in the GLEX group; both are entered as the list states them, by user decision of 18 Nov 2026. Peak days are Monday, Wednesday and public holidays. The peak difference is 838 on the heavy band and 428 on the light band, and the panel holds one weekend figure per handler rather than one per group, so it is entered as a rate of 51 per cent of the handling fee in place of a flat amount: 1,644 x 0.51 = 838.44 and 840 x 0.51 = 428.40, a few cents above the list on both bands, which keeps the panel on the safe side. Out of hours 22:00-06:00 is a flat charge and the panel does allow one figure per group, so the handler keeps 848 and CL60 and E35L carry 433 of their own. GPU 246 per 30 min, toilet 174 and water 174 come from the 17 Nov 2026 quotation and were written to all six groups by user decision of 18 Nov 2026, as was the security night surcharge, 418 on the heavy band and 255 on the light band. Disbursement 16 per cent on third party invoices, as the list states. Cancellation, 50 per cent of the handling rate within 48 hours and 100 per cent within 24 hours, is not entered as a row.
